name: Inbaku Kazoku
source:
Main character leads a normal life of the eldest son. But behind the scenes he abuses his sister. One day letter arrives from his true parent claiming there are no ties between protagonist and the family he lives in. With that information last sibling ties with his step sisters get torn.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角过着长子的普通生活。然而，在暗地里，他却虐待自己的妹妹。一天，他的亲生父母来信，声称主角与现在生活的家庭没有血缘关系。得知这一消息后，他与继妹之间最后的亲情纽带也断裂了。

[改自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
